_about: XY-era English theme decks, xy1 XY through xy12 Evolutions: 24 decks (2 per set), written 2026-11-26. Lists: Bulbapedia deck pages (MediaWiki API wikitext) and TCGsync (tcgosaurus.tcgsync.com product pages' Deck List, copied from the box); all 24 agree card-for-card by name and count (only a TCGsync typo 'Yvelta'; a Bulbapedia Evolutions Energy numbering oddity, see notes). Card ids resolved by set + number in data/<set>.json (xy0 Tierno 39 and g1/base1/bw5 cards used by some decks are kept under their own set ids). Basic Energy: no source names the print; XY 2013 print assumed (ids energy-<type>-xy incl. energy-fairy-xy). TCGplayer: sealed deck in the set's own group; the showcase's Cracked Ice print is in group 1840 'Deck Exclusives' (names like 'Yveltal - 78/146 (Cracked Ice Holo)'; several are named only '(XY <set>)' there but are the deck's cracked-ice print). marketPrice is TCGplayer market (tcgcsv) or null when TCGplayer has no price. Left out: Generations (g1) and Double Crisis (dc1) had no theme decks; xy0 Kalos starter decks and Battle Arena decks skipped as already on the site; Japanese half decks not covered. Not modelled: nothing extra (decks hold exactly 60 cards). The 'Green Tornado Theme Deck Exclusive' product in group 1840 is a Black & White deck, not this era.

decks.name: Resilient Life
decks.showcasePrint: Cracked Ice holofoil print, exclusive to this theme deck (Bulbapedia: 'The Cracked Ice Holofoil version of Xerneas is exclusive to this deck'); the set's own pack print differs. Printed 1 copy as the cracked-ice holo, other copy (if any) regular.
decks.tcgplayerName: XY Base Set Theme Deck - "Resilient Life" [Xerneas]
decks.extras: 60-card deck, damage counters, custom coin (Bulbapedia coin art: XY Silver Xerneas Coin.png), rulesheet, card list, deckbox, two-player mat, TCG Online code card (TCGplayer sells the code card separately as 'Code Card - ...'). No booster pack.

sources.quote: Bulbapedia deck list, 60 cards (28-ish entries); release date and Cracked Ice exclusive trivia
TCGsync product page 'Deck List:' (Pokemon / Trainer / Energy counts) matches Bulbapedia card-for-card

decks.notes: Basic Energy: no source names the print; the XY era's only basic Energy print on the site up to Nov 2016 is the XY 2013 print, so energy print assumed (ids energy-<type>-xy, shared XY 2013 print from ENERGY_PRINTS `xy`, scans assets/cards/shared/energy-<type>-xy.webp). Xerneas is 2 copies: 1 Cracked Ice Holo (deck exclusive) + 1 regular Rare, both xy1-96. The deck's Aromatisse/Slurpuff are the non-holo deck-exclusive prints (the site's xy1-93/95 may be holo). Includes cards of other sets as listed: xy0-39 Tierno. Other deck-only non-holo prints (TCGplayer, Deck Exclusives group 1840): Aromatisse xy1-93 -> 131327 Aromatisse - 93/146 (XY Base Set); Slurpuff xy1-95 -> 131328 Slurpuff - 95/146 (XY Base Set). Showcase TCGplayer product is in the 'Deck Exclusives' group 1840.
